admission.defect: Singleton-only service CRUD APIs force serial callers; parallel singleton and bulk paths duplicate behavior, and inverted bulk adapters can recurse.
admission.upstream: Pinned Ruff 0.17.2 rule catalog has no bulk/delegation relationship rule; BasedPyright checks signatures rather than operation topology.
admission.error_first_authorization: Explicit user request for a blocking rule; exact selector approved without changing other rule policies.

validation.context_regressions: Renamed shared context is accepted in direct/private sync/async adapters; same-named swaps and dropped context still error.
validation.declaration_regressions: Callable static/class/descriptor, alias, overload, decorated and dynamically rebound bulk declarations are deferred, including inherited declarations. Noncallable literal members still fail, and import-proven Protocol contracts are excluded.
validation.local_make_verify: An earlier authoring snapshot reached package tests before its 90-minute budget; that interrupted run is not a complete pass. Final native hooks and exact-head required CI own the remaining qualification.

isolation.pins: Verified before/after. External pins are unchanged; private identities and digests are withheld. The authoring snapshot was explicitly refreshed for the context and declaration-boundary corrections and integration of main a8a98dec. Earlier pins and interrupted attempts remain historical.

findings.inspection: All 9 independent-path findings and 20 missing-bulk findings selected by ascending SHA-256 of their zero-based diagnostic ordinal.
findings.legacy_read_compatibility: get_by_ids is accepted; its inspected existing independent singleton still correctly reports nondelegation.
findings.inspection_reuse: All 86 private finding identities and reasons match the preceding qualified run. Immutable external corpus pins and the same 29 reviewed findings preserve the disclosed inspection evidence.

performance_limits: First analysis and warm repetitions in the same process on four paired authored examples. Memory is process lifetime. Shared VM measurements are noisy; no speedup is claimed. The earlier 16-file comparison and isolated broad corpus timings are preserved privately.
limitations: Module-level Service/Store/Repository CRUD roles only; domain verbs and TypeScript are outside this rule.
Unknown imported ancestry, protocols, variadic, aliased, overloaded, rebound, descriptor and rewriting-decorator contracts are not inferred.
Straight-line adapters and private helpers are bounded to 64 states; complex control flow requires a simpler adapter or exact reasoned exception.
This proves visible delegation topology and input/context forwarding, not SQL batching, result projection, authorization or transaction equivalence.
